theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_cs_valuation_product_separation
theorems.statement: ∀ {K : Type} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (β : Fin n → K) (D : ℤ), (∀ i : Fin n, IsIntegral ℤ (β i)) → (D : K) = (Finset.univ.filter (fun ij : Fin n × Fin n => ij.1 < ij.2)).prod (fun ij => (β ij.1 - β ij.2) ^ 2) → ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime → ¬ ℓ ∣ D.natAbs → ∀ V : ValuationSubring K, V.LiesOverPrime ℓ → (∀ i : Fin n, β i ∈ V) ∧ ∀ i j : Fin n, β i - β j ∈ V.nonunits → β i = β j
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
